note: Roadmap is indicative, not a commitment — priorities can shift.

items.title: Additional database backends
items.note: Run EVE Console on databases beyond the built-in SQLite — starting with PostgreSQL — with migration paths to move your data between database types.

items.title: EVE Mail–driven market orders
items.note: Drive market-order placement, tracking, and updates through in-game EVE Mail.

items.title: Native Linux support
items.note: First-class, compiled Linux releases of EVE Console alongside Windows.

items.title: Standalone background service
items.note: Separate the background workers — ESI polling and syncing — from the desktop client so they can run continuously on their own: headless, on another machine, or in a container.

items.title: Improved Embedded Agent Abilities
items.note: Give the built-in AI agent more EVE and application context, plus an assortment of in-app tools so it can take on tasks you'd otherwise do by hand.

items.title: Alarms
items.note: Complete the alarms system introduced in 0.9.10 — a fuller set of conditions to watch for and ways to be notified.
